reader.requirement: At 85 a numeric-picture item with BLANK WHEN ZERO is of category numeric edited (class alphanumeric, §1985:IV.4.3.3) in every use: refused as an arithmetic operand, non-GIVING resultant or subscript, as a receiver of SPACE and a sender to alphabetic; it takes only nonnumeric VALUE literals, de-edits as a MOVE sender, and in a relation condition is a nonnumeric operand compared by characters (§1985:VI.6.3.1.1.2), with no value-zero exception for an all-spaces image.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002: signed numeric picture promoted to numeric edited under BWZ
ConstructRegistry ValueNumericLiteralNumericEdited2023: a numeric VALUE literal on a numeric-edited item is refused below 2023
DialectLevel < 2002: the numeric operand of a character comparison as its item characters (1985 GR1)
NOTHING: the blanked-sender value-zero arm of §2023:13.18.8.4 GR3 is taken at every edition

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: §2023:13.18.8.4 GR3 (a blanked BWZ sender opposite a numeric or numeric-edited data item has the value zero) has no counterpart in §1985:VI.5.4.4 (two GRs) nor in §2002:13.16.8.3 (two GRs); at 85 the blanked item is a nonnumeric operand like any numeric-edited item
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb535/pb566 cover the category and the stored value; pb509 (accept [85]) asserts the 2023 GR3 results at 85, so the relation range at 85 is witnessed with the wrong expectation

reader.notes: The bind-time consequences of the category conform at 85, but ConditionRenderer.RenderRelational wraps every relation with a BWZ operand in BlankWhenZeroSenderTest, which takes the value-zero arm of 2023 13.18.8.4 GR3 at every edition. At 85 the blanked item is an ordinary numeric-edited (nonnumeric) operand, so it must compare by characters, as the same compiler already does for a plain PIC ZZZ99 item.
